notes: dotnet T2 (`bgraph-eval t2 --ecosystem dotnet`). Root directory defaults to D:/bench/bgraph-eval/t2/dotnet: full clones <dir> detached at R (core.autocrlf=false; global.json rolled forward to the installed SDK 10.0.100 and marked skip-worktree so the tree stays clean), oracle.jsonl. Tools: portable SDK D:/bench/tools/dotnet (DOTNET_ROOT, DOTNET_ROLL_FORWARD=Major, NUGET_PACKAGES=D:/bench/tools/nuget, TEMP/TMP=D:/bench/tools/tmp). Suite: one `dotnet test <project> -f net8.0 -p:CollectCoverage=false --logger trx` per entry of `targets`; the unit is the test project (`dotnet:<project file>`), red when any test of its trx is Failed/Error/Timeout. Baseline = 2 runs at R; red/differing units are excluded; each red project is re-run alone once to confirm. `mutants` = killed mutants aimed at, `tries` = mutants generated at most. Mutants are one-token operator flips (==/!=, <//>=, >//<=, &&/||, + / -, true/false) in non-test C# source under `include`; a mutant that does not compile is recorded as nocompile and not counted.
